note: Twenty-six printed figure numbers become forty-one items because twelve of them are three-panel figures whose panels are separate exports, and Fig. 8 carries a dropped-in screenshot beside its drawn curve. Twelve printed table numbers plus one unlabelled parameter block on p19 make thirteen tables, so the measured 54 regions split 41 + 13 with nothing excluded. Two tool blind spots are recorded here rather than fixed mid-queue: context_extract.py resolves only the first number in a run ('Figure 9, 10 and 11'), so Figs. 10, 11 and 24 have no mention, and its path_for() takes the last heading the page carries, which files the p19 table and Fig. 18 under 6.2 and Fig. 21 under 6.5 although both are printed above those headings; the section paths written here follow the printed order. The Fig. 13 caption is clipped by the gutter after 'in France, USA and', and Table 3's label is printed as 'Tabel 3.'.
rules: The panels of one printed figure share one label line, printed as a run ('Figure 2 Figure 3 Figure 4', 'Figure 5. Figure 6.'), so each panel's caption quotes its own label out of that run [caption.verbatim].
Each panel is its own measured layout block and is recorded as its own item with panel_count 1, which is why 26 printed figure numbers become 41 items [geometry.panel_count].
Family follows the ink: the Fig. 13 panels on p14 are drawn as columns and are recorded as bar, every other plotted block is a connected series and is recorded as line [geometry.family].
The Fig. 1 block is line art with boxed nodes and arrows, not a plot, so it is recorded as flowchart-or-schematic and its printed_numbers is false [geometry.printed_numbers].
The right-hand p9 block is a raster screenshot of a web chart rather than vector ink, so it is recorded as photo-or-raster-image [geometry.family].
Fig. 8 is drawn at the foot of p9 while its caption is printed at the head of p10; the caption quote is still verbatim on the neighbouring page [caption.position].

Series are labelled by inline arrows inside the axes on Figs. 5-8, 12, 17, 18 and 23-26, so those blocks carry legend inside; the one-series blocks on p6, p10, p14, p17, p21, p23, p24 and the Fig. 22 panels carry none [geometry.legend].
The Fig. 13 caption is clipped by the page gutter after 'in France, USA and', so the verbatim caption ends there [caption.verbatim].
Table 3's printed label reads 'Tabel 3.'; the quote keeps the typo and the numbering field uses the nearest closed-enum member, 'Table N.' [caption.numbering].
The p19 block prints three parameter values with no label of any kind, so it is recorded as a table with an empty verbatim and caption_source none [caption.numbering].
Every ruled block in this paper uses vertical rules only, with a shaded header band and no zebra striping [table.rule_style].
Table 7 is the one wide block: eleven columns, ten of them numeric, so it is recorded as full width in portrait [table.cols].
Units are printed inside the stub cells of Tables 4, 5, 7-10, not in the header row, so units_in_header is false there [table.units_in_header].

Figs. 10, 11 and 24 are named only inside a run of numbers ('Figure 9, 10 and 11', 'Figure 23, 24, 25, 26'), which the mention reader resolves for the first number only, so those items carry a null mention with count 0 [mention.count].
The p19 mini table and Fig. 18 are printed above the '6.2' heading, so they are filed under 6.1 rather than under the heading nearest the foot of the page [place.section_path].
